Cove follows a soft crescent line that sits close to the shoulder and leaves room for the small things you reach for throughout the day. Its uncluttered exterior pairs easily with relaxed layers or tailored pieces. A curved top opening keeps the silhouette simple, while the short strap gives it a quiet, compact presence. This demo design explores an everyday proportion; materials, capacity, and measurements must be confirmed with a physical sample before sale.

Arc balances a rounded base with a clean curved flap, creating a shape that feels composed from morning through evening. The short strap follows the same gentle line, and the front remains free of decorative plaques. It is a proposal for a compact companion to a simple wardrobe, with space planned around small essentials. This demo listing is intended for theme testing; all material, fit, capacity, and closure details must be checked before commercial use.
